Deploy preview for *algolia-instantsearch* ready!

Built with commit 25f933391466d4e848db55c630c413b02dc4a75b

https://deploy-preview-2929--algolia-instantsearch.netlify.com
Algobot is just an account that puts the comments from Netlify actually :)

> Hi @algobot are you open source? :)

@zeke As @Haroenv said, you can get this for you just by:
- having a docs build command
- linking your GitHub projects to a Netlify account
- Creating a GitHub user that will be the user posting comments from Netlify (the one having the token)

That's it!
